bio.heading: Hi, I'm Kuko
bio.p1: I'm Kuko Báez (Rodrigo Báez), a watercolor illustrator. I illustrate for editorial projects and books, and paint commissioned pieces for private clients. My work ranges from portraits and figures to animals, landscapes and carnival scenes.

header.heading: Commissions
header.lead: Watercolor illustrations made for your project, from first idea to finished piece.

editorial.title: Editorial illustration
editorial.text: Illustrations for magazines, newspapers and online publications.

books.title: Book illustration
books.text: Covers and interior illustrations for books.

personal.title: Personal commissions
personal.text: A watercolor painted from your references: a portrait, a place, an object or a moment you want to keep.

originals.title: Original artwork
originals.text: Interested in an original from the gallery? Ask me about its availability.

step1.title: Tell me about your project
step1.text: Send a short message with what you have in mind, your references and your deadline.

step2.title: Quote and timeline
step2.text: I reply with a quote and an estimated timeline. Work starts once we've agreed on both. [[TODO: deposit or payment terms, if any]]

step3.title: Sketch
step3.text: I send you a sketch to review before I start painting. [[TODO: number of revision rounds included]]

step4.title: Painting
step4.text: Once the sketch is approved, I paint the final watercolor.

step5.title: Delivery
step5.text: I deliver the finished illustration in the format agreed in the quote. [[TODO: what is delivered — high-resolution scan, file format, the original artwork — and how originals are shipped]]

timing.heading: Timelines
timing.text: Timelines depend on size and complexity. I'll give you an estimate with every quote.
timing.deadline: Working to a fixed date? Mention it in your first message.

brief.heading: What to send
brief.intro: To give you an accurate quote, include:

reference.title: References
reference.text: Photos or any images that capture the idea.

size.title: Size
size.text: The final dimensions (e.g. A4 or 30 × 40 cm), or the print or screen format.

use.title: Use
use.text: Where the illustration will appear: a book, a magazine, a website, a gift…

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.text: The date you need it by.

budget.title: Budget
budget.text: If you have one in mind, it helps me suggest the best option.

notes.title: Extra notes
notes.text: Palette, mood, style or any other detail that helps.

pricing.text: Every project is quoted individually, based on size, complexity and how the illustration will be used.

cta.heading: Ready to start?
cta.text: Tell me what you have in mind and I'll get back to you with the next steps.
